name: RealityKit 3D view
description: A non-AR RealityKit scene in an ordinary screen: virtual camera, light rig, orbit controls, and a bundled USDZ model or a generated placeholder shape.
usage: Show `ModelViewer(modelName: "Chair")` for a bundled `Chair.usdz`, or `ModelViewer(modelName: nil)` for a generated rounded box. The view opts out of world tracking (`content.camera = .virtual`), so there is no camera prompt. Applying this capability raises the app's minimum iOS to 18.0.
statusNote: Not yet built on a Mac; run `ios-agent-mcp capabilities verify realitykit-3d` on a Mac with Xcode.
